name: ediscovery-processing
description: Ingest, search, and analyze local legal evidence (PST, email, chat, court and SharePoint/OneDrive exports) with chain-of-custody. Routes to the shared local legal MCP core. Evidence originals on G:\ stay immutable and read-only; derived indexes live under D:\LocalAI\KnowledgeSystem. Local-only: never route privileged evidence to a cloud model.
